title: Pottery class credit book
brief:
Complete the following real project in the current, initially empty directory. Choose the deliverables, media, tools, structure and implementation that serve the intended user. Build usable artifacts and check your work. Deliver the project itself. Omit personally identifying credits, author signatures and model or toolchain identity labels. No network access or credentials are provided.

Build an offline attendance and credit tracker for a small pottery studio. Each workshop has eight seats, and students may use prepaid visit credits. Start with fictional student codes P01, P02, and P03 with balances of 4, 2, and 1. Add two sample workshops, Tuesday Handbuilding at 18:00 and Saturday Glazing at 10:00. A reservation holds a seat and leaves the balance alone. Attendance uses a credit, while cancellation releases a seat. Support adding workshops, correcting attendance with a visible adjustment, and viewing each student's balance history. Prevent a student from being booked twice into the same workshop.

files.body:
# Kilnbook

Open **index.html** in a current desktop browser. Keep the files together and use the same browser profile and file location each time. All artwork, scripts and styles are included. Records are saved in the browser’s IndexedDB. Clearing browser data or closing a private browsing session can erase them.

The two sample workshops are dated for their next local occurrence when the register first opens. Each is a single session with eight seats.

Use **Open register** to reserve a seat, mark a student attended, or cancel a reservation. Attendance requires one available credit. To remove an incorrect attendance mark, choose **Correct attendance** and enter a reason. This restores the credit and returns the student to reserved. Cancel the reservation as well if the seat should be released.

Select a student under **Student credits** to see dated changes, adjustments and running balances, or add purchased credits. The plus button beside Student credits adds a new student code.

files.name: README.md
files.body:
# Kiln Ledger

Open **index.html** in a regular Chrome or Edge window. Keep the four app files together in one folder. The tracker runs entirely offline and needs no installation or account.

The first launch creates students **P01** (4 credits), **P02** (2 credits), and **P03** (1 credit), plus **Tuesday Handbuilding at 18:00** and **Saturday Glazing at 10:00**. The sample dates are set to the next Tuesday session and the Saturday that follows it. Each workshop has eight seats.

## At the studio

- Select a workshop and choose **Reserve seat**. The reservation holds one seat and leaves the student's balance alone. Each student can hold one seat per workshop.
- Choose **Mark attended** to spend one credit. If the student has no credits left, use **Add credits** before recording attendance.
- Choose **Cancel** to release a reserved seat. A cancelled student can book again if a seat is available.
- Choose **Correct** on an attended row to return the credit. Choose **Reserved** to keep the seat or **Cancelled** to release it, then enter a reason. The original attendance and the credit adjustment both stay visible in **Balance history**.
- Use **Add workshop** to enter a name, date, and start time. Open **Students** to add students, add prepaid credits, or view a student's balance history.

## Saving and backups

Changes save automatically in the browser profile at the file's current location. Reopen the same file in the same browser profile to pick up where you left off. Use **Backups → Download backup** before moving the files, switching browser profiles, or clearing browser data. Use **Restore backup** to load a copy. Restoring replaces the ledger currently open in the browser.
